name: Cable Curl
description: The cable curl uses a low-pulley cable to maintain constant tension on the biceps throughout the full range of motion, including at the bottom where free weights lose tension. This makes it particularly effective as a finishing biceps exercise and is commonly performed with a straight bar or rope attachment.

execution.starting_position: Stand facing a low pulley cable machine holding a straight bar or EZ-bar attachment. Arms extended downward, elbows at the sides.
execution.setup_instructions: Set the pulley to the lowest position. Step back slightly so there is tension on the cable at full arm extension.
steps: Curl the bar upward by flexing the elbows, keeping upper arms stationary.
Raise until full contraction, then lower under control back to the starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the curl, inhale on the descent.
common_mistakes: Allowing the elbows to drift forward
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension at the bottom, full contraction at the top.
coaching_cues: Feel the constant tension throughout the full range
Keep upper arms pinned to sides
